# Spool

> Apache-2.0 local-first and remote printing infrastructure using installed OS
> printer drivers, durable edge queues, and an optional self-hosted control
> plane.

- [README](README.md)

- [Release checks](docs/contributing/releases.md)

## Contracts and operations

- [Native API model](docs/11-native-api-and-data-model.md)
- [PrintNode migration](docs/api/printnode-migration.md)
- [Self-hosting](docs/operations/self-hosting.md)
- [Support matrix](release/support-matrix.yaml)

Physical printing is opt-in and is never performed by ordinary development,
test, fixture-reset, or release-check commands.
